title: A discontinuous Petrov-Galerkin finite-element framework for the simulation of microwave-heated flows
summary: We present a high-order multiphysics solver for the simulation of microwave-heated flows. The solver couples a discontinuous Petrov-Galerkin (DPG) finite element method for the time-harmonic Maxwell equations with continuous Galerkin finite element methods for the heat equation and the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.
